A three-step GPU-based algorithm for computing two light bounces of indirect illumination for Lambertian and glossy materials at interactive framerates [S1].

The claim states that the algorithm is GPU-based, computes two light bounces of indirect illumination, handles Lambertian and glossy materials, and runs at interactive framerates.
